summary: Targeted photo-fix regression testing completed for backend + Expo web mobile preview. Backend pytest passed 17/17 covering: real YouTube Short import (pending->ready), exact source thumbnail ownership, decodable managed JPEG endpoint, refresh-image pending->ready revision update, wrong household/deleted/manual refresh rejections, legacy repaired record invariants, and photo parser unit edge cases (watch query variants, shorts/youtu.be/embed/live, lookalike host rejection, maxres->hqdefault fallback, invalid bytes/tiny logo/private URL rejection, nested/reversed meta parsing). Frontend mobile checks validated onboarding kitchen creation, real Shorts import, detail-screen photo polling, refresh behavior, planner recipe picker photos, planner card photos, library card photos, grocery add action, servings scaler, manual no-source neutral fallback message/icon, and no horizontal overflow in tested screens.

issues: Console warnings still present: deprecated 'shadow*' props and props.pointerEvents usage.

action_items: Optional cleanup: resolve deprecated web warnings for shadow*/pointerEvents.
Optional refactor: split backend/server.py (currently >700 lines) into focused routers/modules per code-review guideline.
Optional env hardening: backend/object_storage.py has fallback default for INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL; policy recommends fail-fast on missing env.
critical_code_review_comments: photo_jobs.public_recipe correctly strips image_storage_path from API responses, preventing storage path leakage.
Refresh flow preserves previous verified image if refresh fails (good resilience behavior).
server.py is now 790 lines, exceeding recommended 700-line split threshold.
object_storage.py uses a default integration URL fallback; env-policy prefers no defaults for fail-fast configuration safety.
